claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the curler for curling lashes quickly and effectively, often noting results in seconds.
Many reviewers highlight the included 5 replacement pads as a valuable bonus.
Reviewers frequently describe the curler as well built, comfortable, and easy to hold with good grip.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including a curler that cut lashes and one described as large, clunky, and ineffective.
Some reviewers mention heating the curler with a hair dryer as a trick, with one warning it can get too hot and burn.
